prompt: In rural parts of Wales, many local people still (speak / talk) Welsh at home.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения языком и общения на нем используется глагол speak.

prompt: Our museum curator in Athens (speak / talk) Greek, French, and English with remarkable ease.
explanation_ru: В контексте владения иностранными языками в 3-м лице единственного числа употребляется форма speaks.

prompt: Could you ask the keynote speaker to (speak / talk) a little more slowly so the court stenographer can record every word?
explanation_ru: В формальной обстановке и при описании манеры речи предпочтителен глагол speak.

prompt: Even during a quiet weekend retreat in the mountains, the two founders couldn't stop (speak / talk) shop.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение talk shop («говорить о работе в нерабочее время») требует герундия talking после глагола stop.

prompt: Please stop (speak / talk) in the back row while I am demonstrating how to calibrate the microscope!
explanation_ru: Для обозначения неформальной болтовни, мешающей занятию, используется talk в форме герундия (talking) после stop.

prompt: The climate scientist has been invited to (speak / talk) at the international forum in Geneva next month.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения официального выступления с докладом или речью на мероприятии используется глагол speak.

prompt: After breathing in thick dust during the collapse, the rescue worker could hardly (speak / talk) when he reached the ambulance.
explanation_ru: Для описания физической способности издавать звуки и произносить слова используется глагол speak.

prompt: Having strained her vocal cords at the outdoor concert, the soprano was barely able to (speak / talk) the following day.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идет о физической возможности пользоваться голосом, употребляется глагол speak.

prompt: Have you ever known an interpreter who can (speak / talk) six languages fluently without confusing them?
explanation_ru: Для указания на способность говорить на иностранных языках используется только глагол speak.

prompt: “Good afternoon, may I (speak / talk) to the director of operations?” — “Speaking.”
explanation_ru: В официальном телефонном этикете для просьбы позвать кого-либо к телефону используется глагол speak.

prompt: You're (speak / talk) rubbish — polar bears only live in the Northern Hemisphere!
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании talk rubbish («нести чушь») используется глагол talk в форме Present Continuous (talking).

prompt: Whenever my uncle and his old teammates meet at the diner, they spend hours (speak / talk) baseball.
explanation_ru: Конструкция talk + тема обсуждения (talk baseball) означает непринужденно обсуждать какой-либо предмет; после spend hours требуется герундий talking.

prompt: Applicants for the diplomatic fellowship must (speak / talk) at least two foreign languages fluently. During the oral exam, they are asked to (speak / talk) for five minutes on a global economic issue. Afterward, the committee members (speak / talk) among themselves before announcing the results.
explanation_ru: Для владения языками (speak languages) и официального монологического выступления используется speak, а для обсуждения между собой (talk among themselves) — talk.

prompt: Do you (speak / talk) Japanese, or did you rely on a translation app in Kyoto? When I visited last spring, I tried to (speak / talk) slowly with shop owners. Most of them were happy to (speak / talk) about local traditions in simple English.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков используется только speak (speak Japanese); для обозначения манеры речи (slowly) предпочтительнее speak, а для беседы на тему (about) естественнее talk.

prompt: When the young pianist heard she had won the gold medal, she was too emotional to (speak / talk). She simply stood on stage and smiled while the audience applauded. Later backstage, she managed to (speak / talk) with her teacher about the final performance.
explanation_ru: В значении физической способности вымолвить слово от волнения используется speak, а для дружеской беседы с кем-то (with) — talk.

prompt: My neighbours love (speak / talk) tennis whenever a major tournament is on. They always invite friends over to watch the matches and (speak / talk) about the players' tactics. However, they never (speak / talk) during an actual rally so they don't miss a point.
explanation_ru: Выражение talk tennis означает «обсуждать теннис»; для непринужденного общения и обмена мнениями в компании используется глагол talk.

prompt: Stop (speak / talk) nonsense — nobody is going to cancel the project over a minor delay. Let's sit down and (speak / talk) through the updated schedule calmly. If necessary, I can (speak / talk) to the client directly this afternoon.
explanation_ru: В устойчивых выражениях talk nonsense («нести чушь») и talk through («подробно обсудить») употребляется talk, а для делового контакта с клиентом предпочтителен speak.

prompt: Please (speak / talk) more quietly — my grandfather is taking his afternoon nap upstairs. If we need to (speak / talk) about the weekend plans, let's go into the kitchen. We can (speak / talk) there without disturbing anyone.
explanation_ru: При просьбе говорить тише (speak quietly) акцентируется громкость голоса (speak), а для обсуждения планов (talk about) и непринужденной беседы используется talk.

prompt: In many districts of Brussels, local shopkeepers ___ both French and Dutch effortlessly.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранными языками и общения на них используется только глагол speak.

prompt: I'm relieved someone in this committee is finally ___ sense about the budget cuts.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое словосочетание talk sense означает «говорить разумные вещи / дело».

prompt: My new colleague grew up in Zurich, so he ___ German as his first language.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков употребляется исключительно глагол speak (в 3-м лице единственного числа — speaks).

prompt: She was so shocked by the sudden loud thunder that she couldn't ___ for a moment.
explanation_ru: Для выражения физической способности произнести слово после испуга или шока используется глагол speak.

prompt: “Central Library desk, good morning. Who's talking, please?”
answer: “Central Library desk, good morning. Who's speaking, please?”
accepted_answers: “Central Library desk, good morning. Who's speaking, please?”
"Central Library desk, good morning. Who's speaking, please?"
explanation_ru: В телефонном разговоре для вопроса «Кто говорит?» используется устойчивая фраза Who's speaking?, а не Who's talking?.

prompt: How many engineers on your team can talk fluent Spanish with our Madrid partners?
answer: How many engineers on your team can speak fluent Spanish with our Madrid partners?
accepted_answers: How many engineers on your team can speak fluent Spanish with our Madrid partners?
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком (fluent Spanish) используется глагол speak, а не talk.

prompt: Hundreds of residents gathered in the town hall to hear the mayor speak to the community.
answer: Hundreds of residents gathered in the town hall to hear the mayor speak to the community.
accepted_answers: Hundreds of residents gathered in the town hall to hear the mayor speak to the community.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: для официального выступления перед аудиторией используется глагол speak (speak to the community).

prompt: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please? I'm trying to copy down the street address.
answer: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please? I'm trying to copy down the street address.
accepted_answers: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please? I'm trying to copy down the street address.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: при просьбе изменить темп или четкость речи естественно использовать глагол speak (speak slowly).

prompt: Two old friends are relaxing in the living room and having a long, warm conversation about their university days. Which sentence sounds most natural?
options: We sat on the sofa with mugs of coffee and talked for hours about our college days.
We sat on the sofa with mugs of coffee and spoke for hours our college days.
We sat on the sofa with mugs of coffee and said for hours about our college days.
We sat on the sofa with mugs of coffee and told for hours about our college days.
explanation_ru: Для непринужденной продолжительной беседы на какую-либо тему используется конструкция talk about.

prompt: You want to say that Leo knew how to use four languages fluently when he graduated from high school. Which sentence is correct?
options: By the time he finished high school in Vienna, Leo spoke four languages fluently.
By the time he finished high school in Vienna, Leo talked four languages fluently.
By the time he finished high school in Vienna, Leo said four languages fluently.
By the time he finished high school in Vienna, Leo told four languages fluently.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения знания языков и умения на них говорить используется только глагол speak (в прошедшем времени — spoke).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence replacing 'talk' with the more appropriate verb for public speaking and voice clarity: Without a microphone in the large stone hall, the guide had to talk loudly and clearly to be heard at the back.
answer: Without a microphone in the large stone hall, the guide had to speak loudly and clearly to be heard at the back.
accepted_answers: Without a microphone in the large stone hall, the guide had to speak loudly and clearly to be heard at the back.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идет о громкости, четкости произношения и выступлении перед группой слушателей, используется глагол speak.
